description: Which malformed or edge bracket patterns are accepted, with which ids and error numbers (and at which call): an unmatched open bracket (alone, after a letter, with text), an open range, an open negation, [!], an empty class [], a reversed range, a one-letter range, a lone close bracket, a close bracket after text, doubled brackets, and an open bracket before * or #? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
